overview.en:
Find Relume library components and retrieve editable React code with its design system.

Find component references and editable React code for a concrete interface need. Keep the selected component and design-system context attached to the implementation brief.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
查找 Relume 组件库内容，获取可编辑的 React 代码及其设计系统。

为具体界面需求查找组件参考与可编辑 React 代码，在实现简报中保留所选组件与设计系统背景。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find a component suitable for this landing-page section.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找适合这个落地页区块的组件。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available React implementation for this component.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个组件的可用 React 实现。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an implementation brief using this component and design system.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 使用这个组件与设计系统准备实现简报。

descriptions.en: Use Relume in Ghast. Find Relume library components and retrieve editable React code with its design system. 查找 Relume 组件库内容，获取可编辑的 React 代码及其设计系统。
